title: Affine sections intertwine the two base-change mates
statement: Let R and B be commutative rings, X a scheme, f:X→Spec R and g:Spec B→Spec R, with fibre product X′ and projections f′,g_X [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-fibre-product]. Use the fixed unbounded derived pullback and direct image [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image] and the fixed affine extension/restriction adjunction and restricted derived sections Γ_f [def-pc-affine-global-hom-base-change-map]. Let E∈D(O_X) with Rf_*E quasi-coherent [def-pc-derived-category]. Suppose s:(g_X)_*;Γ_f ≅ Γ_f′;restriction acts as identity on sections, and c:R(g_X)_*;RΓ_f ≅ RΓ_f′;derived restriction satisfies the right-derived-unit equation via s, exactly as displayed in the Lean signature. There exist an isomorphism a:extension(RΓ_f E) ≅ RΓ_S′(Lg*Rf_*E) and a natural isomorphism d:Rf′_*;RΓ_S′ ≅ RΓ_f′ such that for every L∈D(O_X′) and m:E→R(g_X)_*L, the extension/restriction adjunct of RΓ_f(m);c_L equals a.hom;RΓ_S′(BC_E);RΓ_S′(Rf′_*(adjunct_g_X(m)));d_L, where BC_E is the fixed sheaf base-change map [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. No perfectness or Tor independence is assumed; neither m nor BC_E is asserted invertible.

proof.text: Construct the normalized sections comparisons t,b,z,d,v,r by exists_affineSectionsCompositionComparisons. Its proof derives the identity-on-sections maps through exact scalar restriction and K-injective acyclicity; no separate ringed-space direct-image composition theorem is needed.

Apply exists_affineExtensionSectionsUnit to Q=Rf_*E and hE, with v,r and their normalization equations. Set a to extension of the inverse component of b, followed by the resulting a0. Naturality of the extension adjunction unit gives its unit equation by precomposing the equation for a0 with b.inv.app E.

Use affineSectionsBaseChange_unit_square for the canonical g_X unit. For arbitrary m let n be its g_X adjunct. The adjunction identity gives unit_g_X(E);Rg_X(n)=m. Naturality of d moves Rf'(n) past its component; apply the unit square and cancel b inverse/b hom. Naturality of c then changes the remaining unit composite to RΓ_f(m);c_L.

Apply injectivity of affineDerivedExtensionAdjunction.homEquiv and its unit formula. This proves the required adjunct equality simultaneously for all L and m, with a and d chosen before either binder.

theorem exists_affineSectionsBaseChangeMate
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (A : Type u) [Ring A], HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    {R B : CommRingCat.{u}} {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec R) (g : Spec B ⟶ Spec R)
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (hE : schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec R) ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E))
    (s : RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (pullback.fst f g).toLRSHom.toShHom ⋙
        affineGlobalSections f ≅
      affineGlobalSections (pullback.snd f g) ⋙
        ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} (affineBaseRingMap g))
    (c : schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.fst f g) ⋙
        affineDerivedGlobalSections f ≅
      affineDerivedGlobalSections (pullback.snd f g) ⋙
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} (affineBaseRingMap g)).mapDerivedCategory)
    (hs : ∀ (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (pullback f g).toRingedSpace))
        (x : (affineGlobalSections (pullback.snd f g)).obj F),
      (s.hom.app F) x = x)
    (hc : ∀ J : HomotopyCategory
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (pullback f g).toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ),
      (Functor.rightDerivedFunctorCompUnit
          (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (pullback.fst f g).toLRSHom.toShHom)
          (affineGlobalSections f)).app J ≫
        (affineGlobalSectionsDerivedIso f).hom.app
          ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.fst f g)).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj J)) ≫
        c.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj J) =
      DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((s.hom.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).app J) ≫
        (affineGlobalSections (pullback.snd f g) ⋙
          ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} (affineBaseRingMap g)).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app J ≫
        (affineBaseChangedSectionsDerivedIso f g).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj J)) :
    ∃ a : (affineDerivedExtension g).obj ((affineDerivedGlobalSections f).obj E) ≅
        (affineDerivedGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec B))).obj
          ((derivedPullback g).obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E)),
      ∃ d : schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g) ⋙
          affineDerivedGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec B)) ≅
          affineDerivedGlobalSections (pullback.snd f g),
        ∀ (L : schemeDerivedCategory (pullback f g))
          (m : E ⟶ (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.fst f g)).obj L),
          ((affineDerivedExtensionAdjunction g).homEquiv _ _).symm
              ((affineDerivedGlobalSections f).map m ≫ c.hom.app L) =
            a.hom ≫ (affineDerivedGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec B))).map
              (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g
                (pullback.fst f g) pullback.condition E) ≫
              (affineDerivedGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec B))).map
                ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).map
                  (((canonicalPullbackAdjunction (pullback.fst f g)).homEquiv E L).symm m)) ≫
              d.hom.app L
